hypothesis: W-R24 found complete-row missingness handling insufficient when only one channel is zeroed. A component-level transition-skipping representation may transfer under the same 16-width model, but could confuse legitimately zero readings with missingness. Include unmasked control.
freeze: Prespecify channel-only detection (any candidate channel value 0 is considered unobserved), fixed train/heldout populations, classes and learning budget before first use. No post-result mask thresholds or oracle labels.
source: Original four-channel synthetic observations from affine, quadratic and seeded xorshift generators. No additional validity bit or fifth channel.

training.assignment_rule: For each development seed/entity/swap-index/amplitude choose case at (seed+entity+swap_index+amp)%3 for augmented arms; clean arms always none. Apply case after positive/negative candidate is independently generated.

features: rowaware uses W-R22 original four-zero-row masking; componentzero retains W-R22 16 repeated top-two circular transition mismatch values but excludes a channel's edge if either observed endpoint in that channel is zero (not a privileged mask oracle). Same 16 trainable weights+bias.
classification: CHANNEL_ZERO_TRANSFER iff componentzero_augmented >=0.80 in EACH 12 partial-channel heldout cells and its aggregate partial-channel accuracy exceeds rowaware_augmented by >=0.10; PARTIAL iff latter gain >=0.05 without full strict criteria; NEGATIVE otherwise. Explicitly report unmasked-control quality to expose confusion of legitimate zero with missing observations.
controls: Exact PR parent and frozen source SHA identities
Identical negative and positive example first observation, true clean candidate multiset (only dropout after order), no hidden extra sensors
No recalibration on previously exposed W-R24 heldout seed range288..303
Single archive then final full Go regression; no accepted refs, budget raises or retries
claim_limit: Synthetic component-level missingness inference, not real-world sensor calibration or general intelligence.
